categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies net_processing, txdownloadman, txorphanage, and txrequest.
categories.rationale: Plugs several edge cases in 1-parent-1-child package relay and orphan handling where adversarial peers can stall or block honest CPFP fee-bump packages. As commit 65b48ba1f1 notes, when an assigned announcer disconnects, 'the orphan is never retried... which keeps e.g. a CPFP child of a parent that pays for itself out of the mempool until the orphan is evicted, and an announcer can cause it on purpose.' Resolving these relay liveness holes provides durable protection against transaction-pinning and propagation stalls.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Does not change general testing framework machinery; all tests and the fuzz target exclusively pin P2P relay behavior.
categories.rationale: Does not belong to test infrastructure because tests verifying the behavior of a specific subsystem belong to that subsystem. The tests category explicitly excludes tests of a particular area, noting 'a test that pins the behavior of one area (a wallet migration test, a p2p relay test) belongs to that area, not here.'
